page.overview:
Who is Anna Gregori?

Anna is an elderly Doomsayer who has been drawn to the sites of some of the greatest atrocities in the recent history of the Old World.

She is of the school that believes it is impious to intervene, so she has probably seen more people die than any other living individual. She performs funerals for the dead, taking a tooth as payment.

Her black robes are almost invisible under strings of Human teeth, and her appearance anywhere in the Empire is greeted with utter terror. Those who have tried to attack her personally, however, have met horrible ends, so few dare to do more than run.
